title: Prove multi-contour vector model before boolean tools ship
outcome: Existing vectors migrate to document v6 without visual change, while multi-contour vectors truthfully represent holes and disjoint pieces.
before: Historical packet assumption: VectorLayer stored one contour only and document v6/multi-contour rendering had not landed.
after: Governor reconciliation on 2026-08-27: the packet target already existed on main before this delivery packet was activated. Document v6, VectorLayer.contours, v5-to-v6 widening, compound EvenOdd rendering, contour validation, boolean kernel, reversible vector.boolean command, and Pathfinder UI are already merged and regression-proven. No Builder cycle is legitimate for this packet.
acceptance: A v5 single-contour vector opens through the v6 migration path without moving geometry.
A multi-contour vector with an outer contour and inner hole renders the hole correctly under the explicit compound fill rule.
Multi-contour vectors survive serialize/save/reopen without contour loss.
Validation rejects malformed contour arrays, non-finite coordinates, and out-of-contract contour/node counts.
Document, TypeScript, engine and build gates remain green for the already-landed implementation.
Pathfinder controls on main are classified truthfully as real delivered functionality, not as Phase-0 decorative UI.
evidence: main @ 6d4d7b6 contains commits 84936c2 and 9a22f8e as ancestors
src/document/types.ts defines Contour and authoritative VectorLayer.contours for document v6
src/document/migrate.ts declares DOC_VERSION = 6 and the v5-to-v6 contour stamp
src/engine/compositor.ts renders multi-contour compound paths with EvenOdd fill
src/document/factory.ts validates contour structure and caps
src/document/boolean-ops.ts and vector.boolean implement the real boolean kernel and reversible command path
index.html ships Unite, Minus Front, Intersect and Exclude controls
gap audit: tsc exit 0; unit 316/316; build exit 0; engines PASS; boolean E2E 17/17

builder.notes: Historical reconciliation: the implementation landed before this packet was activated. Assigning a Builder now would create activity without a product delta.

verifier.notes: Historical reconciliation does not fabricate a retroactive pipeline verdict. The Governor closes the stale packet from repository/test evidence supplied by the gap audit.

critic.notes: No new UI is being produced by this reconciliation.

delta.after: The queue records the capability as already delivered and removes VIRO-0002 as an executable implementation packet.
proof: main branch evidence at 6d4d7b6: document v6 multi-contour model and migration are present
main branch evidence: Pathfinder kernel, vector.boolean command, undo/redo path and UI controls are present
gap-audit regression evidence: unit 316/316, tsc/build/engines green, boolean E2E 17/17
regression_protection: tests/transform.test.mjs v5-to-v6 migration invariant and v6 multi-contour round-trip

That work is re-aimed to VIRO-0005.
